title: usedesign.config.yaml
description: The one configuration file of the project. Everything else is description. Lives at the root of the checked repository.

checks.description: Which checks apply to THIS repository (SPEC §7.6). A frontend declares [5]; within the declared scope 'cannot run' still means 'not passed'. This key was honoured by the CLI but absent here — a typo silently dropped the scoping (issue #4); the CLI now refuses unknown keys.

cards.description: Glob patterns locating the operation cards. Optional: a forms-only repository (checks: [5]) has none.

forms.description: Glob patterns locating the form contracts (check 5).

form_inventory.description: Path to the form inventory (schema/form-inventory.schema.json), produced per run by rendering the real components. Without it, check 5 cannot run and is NOT considered passed.

storage_inventory.description: Path to the storage inventory (schema/storage-inventory.schema.json), produced per run from the live store. Without it, check 4 cannot run and is NOT considered passed.

inventory.description: Path to the route inventory (schema/route-inventory.schema.json). Without it, check 1 cannot run and is reported as not run — never as passed.

code_root.description: Root the `maturity_evidence.implemented` paths are resolved against. Without it, the path part of check 3 is reported as not run — never as passed.

evidence_horizon_days.description: How long an unverifiable claim (a dated `deployed`) is accepted before it is reported as stale. Any number is wrong for somebody, which is why it is configurable.

test_report.description: Path to a JUnit XML report from the run being checked. Without it, check 2 cannot confirm that the tests a card names exist and pass, and is reported as not run — never as passed. Freshness is procedural: run the check in the same CI job as the suite. See design/step-coverage.md §6.

exclude.description: Routes that are deliberately not operations: health probes, metrics, generated documentation UI, static assets.

path.description: Glob over the normalised path, e.g. '/health' or '/docs/**'.

reason.$comment: Required, for the same reason a relaxed concurrency policy requires a rationale: an exclusion is a hole in the check, and a hole nobody had to justify is a hole nobody will revisit.
reason.description: Why this is not an operation.
